text:
deploy-bot: starting v2 stealth roll at 09:30 UTC. ramp target 3% -> 12% over 20m. features: header-name normalization + streaming tweak. pinlists: tenant-exclude.csv
carla: quick heads-up 1 1 we had a customer proxy that collapses multiple headers when keys are lowercased, saw it in staging.
tom: staging repro: tenant 'solace' hit 0.8% 5xx at 09:34 UTC on long streams, likely the proxy + header change.
nina: monitor auto-paused slice 3 at 09:35 UTC. revert to v1 done for that slice.
ops-rob: can we pin solace to v1 immediately? runbook says curl pin API.
cs-ivy: I'll draft tenant note. pin command for ops: curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' -d '{"tenant":"solace","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 header normalization causing proxy issues","expires":"2026-04-07T00:00:00Z"}'
carla: pin applied via UI, deploy-bot acknowledged in 20s. solace 5xx down to 0.03% after 3m.
product-omar: release notes action: add Compat note about header normalization, sample pin command, and SDK minimum 1.4.2. add rollback criteria: any tenant >1% 5xx for 5m or pinned tenants >8% of canary -> rollback window.
tom: SDK team will backport header compatibility helper. ETA PR in 2h.
ops-rob: I'll open incident INC-2026-900 and assign oncall. set monitoring watch for 90m.
cs-ivy: sending customer email template now. include pin steps and staging test endpoint.
deploy-bot: monitoring update: canary resumed for unaffected slices. pinned tenants excluded from v2.
carla: thanks all. keeping this thread for follow-ups and release note edits. :white_check_mark:
